method: Complete Codex editorial source review in three disjoint ranges; no game/runtime/world/policy module evaluated. One primary category per actual incident, not quota fitting. Raw reviewer reports are preserved byte-exact beside this file.
expandedLiteralHashMethod: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON of the full review-input row with sort_keys=true, compact separators and ensure_ascii=false; input statically expands literal/helper shape only.
limits: Source review is not a natural encounter, binding execution, runtime eligibility, codec, SQLite, native, every-country/every-context, 30-minute or full-life acceptance.
Historical narrative projection hashes and all raw reports remain exact; current projections differ by the explicitly documented one-field camera-result correction only.
No external-human author approval or shipped-count certification is implied by a Codex source review.
Current candidate gates and release approval are left pending; separate coordinator evidence must name its actual source.
